messages:
Lena M: Heads up
Emergent Health (account exec: @emergent-amy) opened a request to onboard a customer-finetuned 7B into our Private cluster. They want tenant isolation for multiple clinics, DSR-safe logging, and p95 latency <= 120ms for short summaries. Renewal in 3 months; they mentioned potential expansion to Dedicated if pilot goes well.
Omar T: good details. Is the model already quantized? do they expect us to host the checkpoint or bring-your-own?
Sofia P: customer forwarded a tar.gz of the finetuned weights; they expect Redwood to host. They asked for 4-bit quant + KVM encryption at rest, and that inference logs must truncate PHI fields before storage.
Blake C: flagging compliance: DSR and auditability will require Security + Legal signoff. Also need a documented data flow diagram for their compliance team.
Lena M: created that request in CS tracker, but wanted rapid answer on lead times and pilot scope so AM can communicate.
Omar T: lead time: we can unpack and sanity-check weights in ~2 business days, perf + quantization pass ~4 days, security intake ~3 days concurrently if docs are ready. Canary + pilot run add another 3 days. So realistic pilot start ~2 weeks from receipt of final artifacts.
Sofia P: perf target 120ms p95 on our on-prem M60-like nodes may be tight. We should confirm hardware: they listed T4s and "edge-accelerators" in the intake form. If T4, expect ~180-220ms p95 at batch=1. Need to propose either A2 equivalent or adaptive batching with prefix cache.
Lena M: customer replied: they can provision A10G on-site for the pilot if needed but expect cost estimate first. Also asked for a 14-day pilot instead of 7.
Blake C: deliverables checklist before pilot: - Security intake complete (DSR, log redaction) - Model checksum + provenance verification - Quantization report (int4/int8) and quality delta numbers - Perf report on declared hardware - Canary runbook + rollback playbook - Ops contact & run window
Omar T: for quality delta, we'll run a mini-eval: 2k prompts from their redact policy, metrics = ROUGE-L for summary quality, hallucination rate (human-reviewed sample), latency distribution. If ROUGE drops > 5 points on int4, recommend int8 or smaller sequence cap.
Sofia P: also note they requested "no external telemetry" (meaning no third-party APM calls). We'll ensure Console ingestion is limited to aggregated metrics and no raw prompt logging for PHI.
Lena M: I've scheduled a pre-intake sync Wed 9am PT with Emergent infra and security. Please add items to agenda: hardware confirmation, DSR process, traffic profile for pilot, ops window.
OnboardBot: Ticket created: CS-3942 
Emergent Health 7B - Private Onboard (link: https://internal.redwood.ai/sops/onboard/CS-3942) :white_check_mark:
Blake C: renewal risk: HIGH because license upsell tied to pilot success in 3 months. Recommend AM exec touchpoint and weekly progress updates. Put them on the high-touch cohort.
Omar T: I'll own unpacking weights + quantization bench. ETA: unpack + integrity checks within 48hrs of artifacts.
Sofia P: I'll draft the perf and safety eval plan and share a short prompt set template with them. Can someone confirm who will sign the DPA addendum?
Lena M: AM to coordinate legal. I'll update the onboarding sheet with CS-3942, note the renewal timeline, and post the meeting invite.
Blake C: Ops ask: include a brief ops-cost delta for A10G pilot vs T4 fallbacks so AM can present options.
Omar T: noted. Will run quick cost/GPU-hour delta and attach to the perf report.
Sofia P: tagging deliverables pre-sync: security intake docs, artifact upload link, proposed prompt set, pilot traffic profile, cost delta.
Lena M: perfect. I'll close the loop after the Wed sync. Thanks all. :wave:
